memory_update.text: PLPC should remain the primary underfollowed candidate for the transmission_line_hardware node because it has direct product exposure, energy-heavy revenue mix, and installation-specific/robotic hardware signals.

VMI is an adjacent underfollowed grid-hardware candidate: not conductor fittings, but engineered utility structures are project-critical and Valmont disclosed about $1.5B of 2025 US electric utility sales.

HUBB should be treated as the diversified reference competitor/context anchor, not the pure-play expression, because Utility Solutions includes transmission/substation but also broader grid automation, meters, and other utility equipment.

node: Transmission-line hardware, fittings, conductor accessories, and installation-specific components
summary: Expanded the investable universe around transmission-line hardware with a two-lane funnel. Reference lane: Hubbell as the diversified public incumbent and MYR Group as a construction/customer-demand proxy. Underfollowed lane: Preformed Line Products as the clearest US-listed pure-play candidate and Valmont as an adjacent engineered-structures supplier tied to transmission, distribution, and substation buildout. The strongest direct node fit is PLPC; VMI is adjacent but materially exposed to utility structures; HUBB is high-quality context but less pure; MYRG is not a hardware supplier, but its T&D backlog/revenue can help validate upstream order timing.
